mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES and TRANSIT remain near their current troughs, retail footfall stays suppressed because commuting-linked discretionary trips do not recover. This should keep RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks than over the prior four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises relative to the last 28 days despite WORKPLACES and TRANSIT staying within 5 points of their current weekly means.

mechanism_narrative: A further increase in RESIDENTIAL time signals stronger stay-at-home behavior, which directly displaces shopping trips and should push RETAIL_REC down within one to two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL rises above 35 and stays there for a week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline within 14 days after RESIDENTIAL exceeds 35 for a full weekly mean.

mechanism_narrative: If GROCERY_PHARM begins to recover while RETAIL_REC remains deeply negative, it indicates movement is limited to essential trips and nonessential retail demand has not reopened; RETAIL_REC will stay weak over four weeks unless broader mobility rebounds.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM rises by at least 10 points from its current weekly mean
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC improves over the next 28 days even though GROCERY_PHARM rises sharply while other mobility series remain near current levels.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in PARKS activity after the current trough would signal substitution toward outdoor leisure, and that spillover should support retail and recreation visits within two weeks as people resume nonessential outings.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises by more than 8 points from the current weekly mean
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains flat or falls over the next 14 days after PARKS increases by more than 8 points.

mechanism_narrative: When WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both begin to recover together, commuting networks restart and generate incidental retail visits on the same trip chain, lifting RETAIL_REC over the following month.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise relative to the prior 28 days despite simultaneous weekly gains in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT.

mechanism_narrative: If GROCERY_PHARM falls further from its already elevated negative level, it implies even essential errand intensity is contracting; that broader caution should reduce retail visits within one week.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline within 7 days after GROCERY_PHARM moves below -60.

mechanism_narrative: Under a persistent lockdown regime, any continued suppression of TRANSIT above the current extreme low will keep spontaneous retail trips constrained. RETAIL_REC should therefore remain below the last four-week average over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC exceeds its prior 28-day mean even though TRANSIT stays near its current weekly mean or lower.

mechanism_narrative: If PARKS and RESIDENTIAL both rise together, outdoor local activity substitutes for shopping travel and keeps discretionary retail suppressed. The interaction should predict lower RETAIL_REC over the next two to four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 14 to 28 days despite simultaneous rises in PARKS and RESIDENTIAL.
